scope: 35 newly recognized Ability components, 27 fully supported additional cards; no previous supported program or metadata changes.

boundaries: Only exact optional HAND and SELF entry/evolution events on the controller turn; old Ability prefixes remain rejected.
Opening setup and deck entry do not trigger these hand-entry effects; automatic events cannot be manually activated.
Random hand shuffle is server-rolled, reveals selected identities and moves physical cards to their owner deck; short hands resolve as much as possible.
Absent Stadium does not prevent the source Pokemon from entering play; a Stadium lost before queued resolution is harmless. Manual no-effect activation still fails.
Search/recovery and Energy choices retain owner privacy, exact category, distinct targets, and stale-choice rejection.
No downgrade, prior supported program change or metadata change.
